Pinned interpretation: intrabar stop fills at the STOP price with slippage debited as a separate per-fill cost component (not price-adjusted), uniformly for all fills, per 'stop fills at stop price with slippage bps against' + cost_debit_law.
SPY books its single all-in 10 bps/fill band as costs_fee with zero slippage component (cost_contract has one combined number); BTC books fee 5 bps and slippage 1 bps separately.
